method: Both reviewers read every German string of the current file again. That covered title and title.canDo, spec.situation and the new spec.deviation (four points, each checked against the content), the Folge (8 lines) and its gist item, and the three inputs: the LS1 chat (10 lines plus Sophie's timetable), the LS2 machine and counter (10 lines plus the machine screen) and the LS3 platform and train scene (10 lines plus the departure board). It also covered the 9 LS4 texts, both strategy cards, 8 redemittel, both speaking parts (instructionsDe, situationDe, cards), aiRole, openingLine, 8 hintWords and 16 model turns, the S2 task (situation, taskDe, 3 Leitpunkte with cues, checklist, model text), the 2 check lines, the 3 micro-outputs, both Aussprache blocks, story.beat and the cliffhanger, every endLine, modelSentence and explanation.de, the 31 u10 entries of a1.1/lexicon.json (gloss and example = the word cards) and the three rule cards the unit shows (rc.trennbare-verben, rc.vokalwechsel, rc.wortbildung-er-in). We solved all 95 authored items blind from promptDe plus options, tiles or audio line: start gist 1, input 15, structured input 12, pool 33, reserve 13, exam 9, check 8 and proof 4. For sentence_building we permuted the tiles, including the V1 questions with „auch“ and „noch“. For error_correction we tried every correction that keeps the meaning, now that four prompts name „die Endung“ or „das Verb“. We ran 47 candidate answers through the real grader, src/lib/course-v2/checkItem.js, plus a synthetic clock-time key without listed zero forms (results quoted in previousFindings, F03 and F07). We compiled a1.1 into the scratchpad (node scripts/course-v2/compile.mjs a1.1 --out <scratch> --banks-out <scratch>), so nothing was written to the repo, and ran the server's own normalizeSpeakingTask and buildCoursePartnerPrompt (netlify/functions/_shared/speakingAI.mjs) on the compiled a11-u10-s entry (F01). We read LEX-03.mjs (bracket-cue parser, dictation check), ITM-01.mjs (correction-naming rail), ALL-02.mjs, the metalanguage allowlist and WritingTaskView.jsx cueFound to see which r1 rails exist. We checked exam fidelity against content/course-v2/registries/lanes/sd1.json (h2: 4 × R/F, 1 play, textWords [29, 47]; l3: 5 × R/F, signs with their location, [10, 25]; sp2 cards-ask, 2 rounds; sp3 cards-request, everyday objects, an information question is sent back; s2: 3 Leitpunkte, about 30 words, Anrede and Gruß outside the Leitpunkte) and against the rubric files sd1-sp2 and sd1-sp3. We checked the cast against casts/series.json and casts/a1.json (Arjun Informatiker as in u03, Sophie studies in Leipzig and has parents in Dresden, Olena, Emre and Arta in the A1 course, Emre online from İzmir, Frau Schulz Kursleiterin, Herr Richter in the office, ensemble-a1-3 at the Bahnschalter, ensemble-a1-2 Mitreisende), and the story against u09 (Sophie's Wednesday call, word for word; Friday dinner at the Restaurant Kochi) and u11/u12 (Priya in Dresden with Arjun and Sophie, one hour delay on the way home, Sophie back on Wednesday, Priya in the course on Tuesday). All times and prices were recomputed and still hold (9.10 → 10.25 and 18.35 → 19.50 are 1 h 15; 88 € = 2 × 2 × 22 €; 11.20 + 20 = 11.40; 14.00 + 30 = 14.30; 10.25 → 10.40 = 15 min; the bus 8.30 → 8.45, Sophie at 8.50). The MC key positions of the non-exam items are b 14 / a 11 / c 10, so the u04 r4-F03 class does not recur.

verdict: Not exit-ready: 1 BLOCKER, 1 MAJOR, 6 MINOR. The r1 fixes landed well. Of r1's 20 findings, 14 are fixed or fixed in the unit, 3 are partly fixed (F05, F11, F14) and 3 are open with their owners (F08, F19, F20). One of the fixes in the unit (F07) does not yet reach the product. The validator is green, every key is right, every correction names what to correct, the platz-frei and fahrplan proofs now need German, the Sp2 partner asks as a candidate, and the listening slips and the story breaks r1 found are repaired. Every claim in the new spec.deviation is true. Two things stop exit, and the unit owns neither. (1) F01, BLOCKER. The engine defect of u01 r2-F01 and u08 r2-F01 hits this unit harder since r1: the server drops `parts`, so the AI partner gets Teil 2 without its cards and never runs Teil 3, and the whole session is scored with sd1-sp2. r1-F07's fix put the learner's seat request, and the „eine Fahrkarte kaufen“ half of cd.a1.fahrkarte-schalter, into exactly that Teil 3, and sd1.sp3 is the unit's Prüfungsfokus Teil for Sprechen. (2) F02, MAJOR. The rule card still says „Wörter auf -er sind der, Wörter auf -in sind die.“ It also teaches with three nouns the learner does not know (Fahrer, Spieler, Verkäufer) and does not cover Student → Studentin, which half of the unit's items use. The six minors: the receptive-lemma class has grown, and a LEX-03 parser gap hides it (F03). Four u10 word cards tell a different timetable (10.15, Gleis 3, change in Riesa; F04). Teil 3 is set in a train where the learner buys a ticket from a fellow passenger (F05). The learner is still on a Saturday train with three seats for four (F06). The grader still rejects a right number with its unit word (F07). And two of our own r1 proposals left small new problems (F08). The unit's own edits are small: two situationDe lines, one hint word, one model turn, one redemittel, three option or focus strings (F05, F06, F08). For the level: A1.1 cannot be declared finished before the E1 server track reads `parts`.

scoreNotes.D: Every line on a model surface is grammatical, and du/Sie is right in every relationship: du among the friends and in the chat messages to Olena, Emre and Sophie; Sie with the clerk, the bus driver, Nora and in all instructions. r1's slips are gone (t2, t3, t4, ls3-l04, „nur Geld“, „bei Olena“). It stays at 4 because one model exchange is pragmatically wrong: in a train scene the learner buys „Eine Fahrkarte nach Dresden“ from a fellow passenger (F05).
scoreNotes.N: Production stays within the u10 ceiling (separable verbs, vowel change, -er/-in, V1 questions, dative chunks), and every read surface uses known words, metalanguage or a gloss. It scores 3 because the rule card for the unit's new point is false as stated and teaches with unknown nouns (F02), and because the unit drills that point in typed production on receptive lemmas, in the scored Check included (F03).
scoreNotes.H: The trip is lively and connected: Sophie's call continues u09 word for word, the timetable arrives in the chat, the machine refuses Priya's card, Arjun buys at the counter, a platform change sends them to Gleis 14, a bus driver shares their table, and the cliffhanger's one-hour delay is exactly what u11 retells. Every can-do is designed into an item or the Aufgabe, and the learner now asks for a seat. It is 4 and not 5 because, in the running session, that request and the ticket purchase sit in a Teil 3 that the engine neither runs nor scores (F01).
scoreNotes.A: Every key is right, and the German prompt decides every item, including the reworked q01, q04, ls3-s02 and ls3-s04. The -in and verb corrections name what to correct, and the fronted orders are accepted with acceptedWhy. It stays at 4, not 5, because the grader still marks „Gleis 3“, „88 Euro“ and „10 Minuten“ WRONG where the number is right (F07), and because ls1-i05 lost its heard distractor (F08).
scoreNotes.P: H2 is exact to sd1.json: 4 announcements of 32/36/39/32 words (whitespace count; TXT-02 passes), one play, R/F keys F R F R, with the sound trap „zehn Minuten“ → „Gleis 10“ in h2-03. L3 has 5 signs with their location, R/F keys F R R F R, of 16/14/14/12/17 words, within [10, 25]. Sp2 has two rounds with one card per candidate and round, and candidate questions. S2 has 3 separate Leitpunkte, 25–35 words, informal register, with Anrede and Gruß in the checklist, not as Leitpunkte. All texts are original. It scores 2 because the Sprechen task is delivered and scored on the wrong basis: the AI runs Teil 2 without cards and never runs Teil 3, the fokus Teil, and the whole session is graded with sd1-sp2 (F01). Teil 3's train framing and its bare-question hint word add a small deviation (F05).
scoreNotes.K: Cast facts match the registries and the earlier units (Arjun Informatiker as in u03, Sophie's parents in Dresden, Emre and Arta online learners, Frau Schulz a teacher, Herr Richter not). The handovers to u09 and u11 hold, and r1's contradictions (the Friday dinner, Sophie's ticket, the U-Bahn in Leipzig) are repaired. It stays at 4 for small residues: four u10 word cards give a different arrival time, platform and change (F04), and the micro-outputs still count the learner into a group of three (F06).
scoreNotes.E: Each Lernschritt keeps its r1 structure, instructions stay within 90 characters, the pre-submit cues now recognise „kommt“ and „14:30“, and every end screen names the win. It is 4 and not 5 because the LS5 screen shows the learner two Teile with cards, while the AI partner knows neither the cards nor Teil 3 (F01), and the LS3 Aussprache line has grown to 31 German words of metalanguage (F08).

Owned outside the unit: F01 (E1 server track), F02 (rule-cards owner; lexicon owner for lx.busfahrer), F03 (lexicon owner and rule-smith; the unit fallback is optional), F04 (lexicon owner) and F07 (checker owner).

exitCheck.note: Exit needs 0 BLOCKER, 0 MAJOR, every criterion at 4 or above and at most 5 logged MINOR. F01 is the gate, and the unit does not own it: the E1 server track must read `parts` and score each Teil with its own profile. F02 needs the rule-cards owner. After those two and the three unit edits (F05, F06, F08), P and N return to 4 and three owner-held minors remain (F03, F04, F07), within the limit. Re-review needs no full content round: play one a11-u10-s session after the engine fix (the result must show a Teil 3 score), read the new rule card, and re-read the edited lines. Class findings for the rule-smith: F01 (the compiled-bank test), F02 (GRM-05), F03 (LEX-03), F04 (LEX-07) and F07 (checker test). Stop-the-line (§9.4) is in force for four classes that now recur in three or more a1.1 units: the speaking engine's `parts` (u01, u08, u10), rule cards whose simplification is false (u04, u08, u10), receptive lemmas that must be produced (u04, u08, u10), and word cards that contradict their unit (u01, u08, u10).

findings.problem: This is the engine class of u01 r2-F01 and u08 r2-F01. u08 r2 already listed u10 among the affected units, and nothing in speakingAI.mjs has changed. r1-F07's fix has made this unit depend on it more. The AI partner, however, is given Teil 2's procedure with empty card lists, is told to thank and stop once the cards are done, and never runs Teil 3. speakingV2 grades the whole transcript with sd1-sp2 (2 points per question, 1 per answer). sd1-sp3's criteria (bitte 2, reaktion 1 per turn) have no place in the session. findings.quote: „Aus einem Verb wird eine Person: Verbstamm + -er. fahren → der Fahrer, spielen → der Spieler, verkaufen → der Verkäufer (manchmal mit Umlaut). Für Frauen kommt -in dazu: die Fahrerin, die Spielerin, die Verkäuferin. Wörter auf -er sind der, Wörter auf -in sind die. Plural: die Fahrer, die Fahrerinnen.“ (unchanged since r1)
findings.problem: r1-F08 is open: the card is byte-identical. Its rule „Wörter auf -er sind der, Wörter auf -in sind die.“ is false as stated (die Mutter, Schwester, Tochter, Nummer; das Wasser, Zimmer, Fenster; der Termin), and the same step still shows „Meine Mutter …“ (ls3-r04) and the Sp3 card „Wasser“. Two gaps are new in this round. (1) The card teaches with nouns the learner cannot know. Fahrer and Verkäufer are allocated to a1.2-u02. Spieler and verkaufen are in no lexicon of any level. The unit's own known person nouns (Lehrer, productive since u02; Kellner, Informatiker, Teilnehmer; Busfahrer from the input) are not on the card. (2) The card presents -in only as the partner of a verb noun in -er. Half of the unit's -in items build on nouns that are neither: Student → Studentin (ls3-p02, ls3-p09), Freund → Freundinnen (ls3-p11), and Informatiker and Kellner, which come from no verb.
